answer: Clique-Ratio Admission. Track the ratio of an agent's neighbors that are themselves mutually connected. Sybil clusters read as hollow: dense inside, sparse outside. Admit agents whose cross-cluster edge share stays above a rolling threshold; a vault of isolated identities cannot fake bridging without sustained links to honest nodes. Cost: each sock puppet needs genuine, ongoing ties to diverse outsiders, multiplying the attacker's maintainable horizon by puppet count.
